grade_reason: No statement by Mark Tedford about AI, let alone catastrophic AI risk, was found in news, campaign coverage or Oklahoma House sources since 1 January 2025.
notes: 7 web searches ran, none refused. No campaign website was found in results; the Tulsa Flyer profile of his congressional race (https://tulsaflyer.org/2026/06/09/government/post/mark-tedford-us-house-race/) was opened and has nothing on AI. He was not a member of Congress, so he did not co-sponsor the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act or sign the House letters. A search result snippet from an Oklahoma House calendar (https://former.okhouse.gov/CalendarFiles/2026/2026_hcal29.pdf, could not extract text) lists SB 1876 'By Reinhardt of the Senate and Tedford of the House' with the description 'Technology; artificial intelligence; chatbots; companions; minors; safety; civil penalties'. The Oklahoma legislature bill page (http://www.oklegislature.gov/BillInfo.aspx?Bill=SB1876&Session=2600) confirms Tedford as principal House author but shows the title 'Service of process; modifying persons that may be appointed as agent', approved by the Governor 05/11/2026, so the bill's content at passage is unclear. Either way it concerns child safety with AI chatbots, which is level D under the rubric, and it is not a statement of his own, so it was left out of record. Search snippets also linked a Tedford to 2024 AI health insurance utilization review bills (HB 3094, HB 2326), before the 2025 period.
